doc: GPT-1 (OpenAI): GPT-2's tensors (Conv1D weights [in, out], fused c_attn, learned positions from 0, ungated MLP, scaled attention) under the names tokens_embed / positions_embed, in a POST-norm block - h = ln_2(n + mlp(n)) with n = ln_1(x + attn(x)) - with no final norm, the activation read from afn, a tied head. The class is OpenAIGPTLMHeadModel (not ...ForCausalLM), so the template alone refuses it. PENDING VALIDATION (written during the quiet window). Third-party adapter (lane H): data only, extends the built-in gpt2.
